# Zahid Hasan Tonmoy

> MERN Full Stack Developer, Data Analyst & AI Agent Developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Zahid Hasan Tonmoy is a computer science student at Daffodil International University (2021–present) who builds full-stack web applications, data science tools, AI agents, and mobile apps. He has delivered 9+ projects spanning web apps, mobile apps, IoT systems, and machine learning models. He is available for freelance, contract, and full-time work internationally.

## Projects

- [Flexpath](https://github.com/zahidhasantonmoy/Flexpath): Gig economy mobile app for Bangladesh — Flutter, Supabase, PostgreSQL; NID verification, real-time chat, role-based dashboards
- [Gold Price Predictor](https://gold-price-predictor-2f1h.onrender.com/): ML regression app predicting daily gold prices with R² ≈ 0.9999 — Python, Scikit-learn, Flask
- [Curious Cart BD](https://curiouscart.vercel.app/): Full-stack e-commerce platform — Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST API
- [Jerseyvault](https://jerseyvault.vercel.app/): Full e-commerce platform with order tracking, wishlist, reviews — React, Supabase, PostgreSQL
- [Vortex Shield](https://protocolzero.vercel.app/): File encryption suite with AES-GCM and Argon2id — Python, CustomTkinter, React, TypeScript
- [LocalDrop Pro](https://localdrop-one.vercel.app/): P2P browser-to-browser file transfer via WebRTC with AES-GCM encryption — React, PeerJS, PWA
- [Smart Drainage System](https://github.com/zahidhasantonmoy/smartdrainagesystem): IoT flood prevention system — ESP32-S3, MicroPython, Firebase, Android
- [Halarnati](https://halarnati.free.nf/): File and text sharing platform for Bangladeshi users — PHP, MySQL
- [OffenseOrbit](https://github.com/zahidhasantonmoy/OffenseOrbit): Crime management platform for citizens and law enforcement — PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap
